print(f"Handover position: {handover_pos}")

# Orientations
# Arm0: facing down, opening along Y (to grasp handle which is along Y)

# Arm1: facing down, opening along Y

# --- Phase 1: Arm 0 picks up the hammer ---

# 1a. Move Arm 0 above the handle
approach_pos = np.array([handle_pos[0], handle_pos[1], handle_pos[2] + 0.15])
print(f"Arm0 approach: {approach_pos}")
joints = solve_ik_arm0(approach_pos, q_arm0_grasp)
move_to_joints_arm0(joints)

# 1b. Descend to grasp position
grasp_pos = np.array([handle_pos[0], handle_pos[1], handle_pos[2]])
print(f"Arm0 grasp: {grasp_pos}")
joints = solve_ik_arm0(grasp_pos, q_arm0_grasp)
move_to_joints_arm0(joints)

# 1c. Close gripper
close_gripper_arm0()
print("Arm0 gripper closed")

# 1d. Lift up
lift_pos = np.array([handle_pos[0], handle_pos[1], 0.175])
print(f"Arm0 lift: {lift_pos}")
joints = solve_ik_arm0(lift_pos, q_arm0_grasp)
move_to_joints_arm0(joints)

# 1e. Translate to handover midpoint (move in X and Y separately to avoid collisions)
# First move in X
mid_x_pos = np.array([midpoint_x, handle_pos[1], 0.175])
print(f"Arm0 mid-X: {mid_x_pos}")
joints = solve_ik_arm0(mid_x_pos, q_arm0_grasp)
move_to_joints_arm0(joints)

# Then move in Y to reach handover point
print(f"Arm0 handover: {handover_pos}")
joints = solve_ik_arm0(handover_pos, q_arm0_grasp)
move_to_joints_arm0(joints)

# --- Phase 2: Arm 1 approaches and grasps ---

# 2a. Arm 1 moves above the handover point
arm1_approach = np.array([midpoint_x, 0.0, 0.35])
print(f"Arm1 approach: {arm1_approach}")
joints = solve_ik_arm1(arm1_approach, q_arm1_grasp)
move_to_joints_arm1(joints)

# 2b. Arm 1 descends to handover position
arm1_grasp = np.array([midpoint_x, 0.0, 0.175])
print(f"Arm1 grasp: {arm1_grasp}")
joints = solve_ik_arm1(arm1_grasp, q_arm1_grasp)
move_to_joints_arm1(joints)

# 2c. Close Arm 1 gripper
close_gripper_arm1()
print("Arm1 gripper closed")

# --- Phase 3: Arm 0 releases and retracts ---

# 3a. Open Arm 0 gripper
open_gripper_arm0()
print("Arm0 gripper opened")

# 3b. Arm 0 retracts upward
arm0_retract = np.array([midpoint_x, 0.0, 0.35])
print(f"Arm0 retract: {arm0_retract}")
joints = solve_ik_arm0(arm0_retract, q_arm0_grasp)
move_to_joints_arm0(joints)

# 3c. Arm 1 lifts the hammer
arm1_lift = np.array([midpoint_x, 0.0, 0.25])
print(f"Arm1 lift: {arm1_lift}")
joints = solve_ik_arm1(arm1_lift, q_arm1_grasp)
move_to_joints_arm1(joints)

print("Handover complete!")
